Q092-01.notes: Negative slope through (2,6) forces both intercepts positive. Intercepts a,b: 2/a+6/b=1, ab=50 -> b+3a=25 -> b^2-25b+150=0 -> b=10 or 15. Greatest is 15 (a=10/3). Needs the intercept-form setup and choosing the larger root.

Q092-02.notes: b=2a+1 and a=3b-13 -> a=2, b=5. Swapped-coordinate trap (a=2 also comes out of the solve).

Q092-03.notes: x15: 5x+20-3x+6<60 -> x<17, so greatest integer is 16. Trap: entering 17, or a sign error on -3(x-2).

Q092-05.notes: 1/x+1/(x+2)=5/12 -> 5x^2-14x-24=0 -> x=4, so the greater number is 6. Trap: entering 4. Easy to guess and check.

Q092-06.notes: Differences: a(b-1)=6 and ab(b-1)=18 -> b=3, a=3, c=2. f(3)=3*27+2=83. Needs the difference/ratio insight.

Q092-08.notes: 0.8p+0.3(1-p)=0.65 -> p=0.7. Distractors: A=0.35 (stopping at 0.5p=0.35), D=0.65/0.8. All four are plausible.

Q092-09.notes: Center (h,2h) equidistant from both points: 50-30h=34-22h -> h=2, k=4. r^2=(1-2)^2+(7-4)^2=10. Check with (5,3): 9+1=10.
